established_mechanism: Every non-MPA HTML embeds the entire pageToHashMap generated from Rollup page chunk filename hashes. A changed map entry propagates to every HTML; this is content-derived metadata, not proof of random generation.
unproved: Old HTML and old map bytes were not saved, only SHA and byte lengths. The exact historical changed entry/value and complete cause of this specific cross-build difference cannot be reconstructed from current evidence.
verifier_scope: Fragment verifier reads and parses built HTML and does not write site content. No normalization or production change was applied to bypass failed input equality.
